page: Microsoft Azure F1alds_v7 is an entry-level compute-optimized virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. It provides a single dedicated physical core and single vCPU powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at up to 4.5 GHz. The CPU subsystem includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside instruction set support for AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16), AES, and SHA-NI. The instance is paired with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, and includes a bundled 118 GB local NVMe SSD. It contains no GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-thread execution metrics, reflecting the high clock speed of the underlying AMD EPYC processor. Single-core stress-ng tests achieved 3695.58 points, placing it in the top decile of single-thread compute measurements. Data compression tests reflect similar strengths, with single-threaded gzip compression achieving 40.41 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression measuring 17.95 GB/sec. Large-block memory bandwidth benchmarks registered 41.1 GB/sec for reads and 32.18 GB/sec for writes. Conversely, because the instance relies entirely on a single vCPU, aggregate multi-core throughput and overall system benchmarks such as PassMark CPU (3431.27) and memory performance (997.59) remain in lower comparative percentiles.

In operational benchmarks, the instance registered 3.74 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 2.77 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. For lightweight machine learning inference, prompt processing with a 135M parameter model reached 416.19 tokens per second, with text generation at 173.14 tokens per second. The primary hardware bottleneck is the small 2.0 GB memory footprint, which restricts memory-intensive tasks and multi-threaded scaling despite the rapid local NVMe disk and high single-core compute performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the F1alds_v7 offers access to modern Zen-based CPU features and fast NVMe scratch storage at minimal resource allocation. Workloads suited for this server type include lightweight utility processing, single-threaded batch scripts, microservices, small CI/CD validation steps, and entry-level proxy routing.
description: Microsoft Azure F1alds_v7 is a compact compute-optimized virtual machine operating on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features a single dedicated vCPU derived from an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at 4.5 GHz, accompanied by 32 MB of L3 cache and AVX-512 vector support. The system is equipped with 2.0 GB of memory and a bundled 118 GB local NVMe SSD, but does not include GPU acceleration. Driven by its high CPU frequency, the instance exhibits top-tier single-core performance, delivering 3695.58 in stress-ng single-core tests and 40.41 GB/sec in gzip compression. Overall multi-core and memory capacity metrics remain low due to the single-core design and 2.0 GB memory ceiling. The instance is designed for single-threaded processing, lightweight web serving, and development utilities.
